priorityList: Maintain Instant Poison and keep Slice and Dice active (automatically refreshed by Dispatch).
Use Roll the Bones if no buffs are active or if only one buff is active.
Cast Adrenaline Rush whenever it is not currently active.
Use Keep It Rolling if you have at least 2 Roll the Bones buffs active.
Use finishers (Between the Eyes, Dispatch, Killing Spree) when you have 6 or more combo points.
Cast Between the Eyes as your highest priority finisher.
Use Coup de Grace immediately if the Disorienting Strikes buff is active (as a builder) or as a finisher.
Cast Killing Spree as a finisher if Between the Eyes is on cooldown.
Use Dispatch as a finisher to spend remaining combo points.
Use Preparation if Adrenaline Rush has >30s remaining and Killing Spree is on cooldown.
Use Vanish to trigger Hidden Opportunity if you do not have Audacity or Opportunity buffs active.
Use Blade Rush if your energy is low or during Adrenaline Rush.
Use Ambush as your primary builder if Audacity or Hidden Opportunity is active.
Use Pistol Shot if Opportunity is active and at max stacks, or if you have a large combo point deficit.
Use Sinister Strike as your basic filler to generate combo points.
